response.answer: I’d decline or ask to attend only if it can be moved to a day after normal sleep. After covering the cancellation list overnight, you reported thin concentration and needing quiet time, and night triage has worsened migraines—especially with noise and screens. You have tolerated meetings and team events when you had slept normally. You could say: “Thanks for the invitation. I’m covering the cancellation list overnight beforehand, so I won’t be at my best for an afternoon offsite. Could I join a future session or receive the notes instead?”
